title: Sm4
summary: The symmetric block cipher from China's SM (ShangMi) national standard suite, providing 128-bit encryption. Available in SORA Nexus alongside SM2 (asymmetric) and SM3 (hash) for deployments requiring full compliance with Chinese cryptographic regulations in financial and government sectors.
